_help: Wheel/odometry CSV: timestamp_ns,linear_speed_mps,yaw_rate_radps in the camera timestamp clock domain. Exact visual t0/t1 must be bracketed; interpolate velocities and integrate only that interval. Missing boundary coverage, internal gaps or invalid values returns unavailable. Camera/recording uses input_csv, ROS uses odom_topic; do not set both. IMU is reserved and is not fused.
